map.判断反应进行的方向: Determining the direction a reaction proceeds
map.输入反应物与生成物的浓度及系数，求反应商 Q 并与 K 比较。: Enter the reactant and product concentrations with their coefficients to get the reaction quotient Q and compare it with K.
map.📖 查看「判断反应进行的方向 使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Determining the Direction a Reaction Proceeds Usage Guide"
map.Q = [P]^ν_P / [R]^ν_R（气相用分压）。 QK 逆向。: Q = [P]^ν_P / [R]^ν_R (partial pressures for gases). Q < K forward, Q > K reverse.
map.📚 深度解析：判断反应进行的方向: 📚 Deep Dive: Determining the Direction a Reaction Proceeds
map.方向判定：算 Q 对比 K 知反应向哪走。: Direction: compute Q and compare it with K to see which way the reaction goes.
map.初始状态：由投料算 Q 预判趋势。: Initial state: compute Q from the feed to predict the trend.
map.平衡点逼近：随反应进行 Q→K。: Approaching equilibrium: as the reaction proceeds, Q moves toward K.
map.输入各物质浓度算 Q，工具对比 K 输出「Q<K 正向进行」或「Q>K 逆向」，: Enter the concentrations to compute Q; the tool compares it with K and reports "Q < K, proceeds forward" or "Q > K, reverse", noting that Q = K means equilibrium.
map.Q 和 K 单位一致吗？: Do Q and K share the same units?
map.都用相同活度/浓度基准，K 无量纲（标准态归一）。: Both use the same activity/concentration basis, and K is dimensionless (normalized to the standard state).
map.达平衡，正逆净速率为 0。: Equilibrium is reached and the net rate in both directions is zero.
map.压强变化影响 Q 吗？: Does a pressure change affect Q?
map.气体用分压表达时总压变改各分压，Q 随之变。: When gases are expressed as partial pressures, a change in total pressure changes each partial pressure, and Q changes with it.
